title: teamBOX
tagline: I am building a decentralized business communication platform supporting workspace chat, video conferencing, and file storage.
description:
I am building a decentralized business communication platform supporting workspace chat, video conferencing, and file storage
This application can be used for teams to communicate using specific teamroom aka teamBOXes. I have implemented MeetRooms using huddle for real-time communication, lighthouse sdk to store and access teamDocs, and Push chat for communication.
